parse_file_config: parse a YAML or YAML-like config file into an OmegaConf DictConfig object
recursively_parse_config: recursively resolve config file references and merge them into an ordered list of DictConfigs
parse_args_with_default: merge CLI arguments with a default config and resolve all variables into a plain Python dict
get_pydantic_default_args: extract default field values from a Pydantic BaseModel class into a plain dictionary
parse_args_to_pydantic_model: parse CLI arguments and merge with defaults to instantiate a Pydantic BaseModel instance
